record.original_title: Сунъий интеллект технологияларини 2030 йилга қадар ривожлантириш стратегиясини тасдиқлаш тўғрисида / Об утверждении Стратегии развития технологий искусственного интеллекта до 2030 года
record.summary: Presidential resolution approving Uzbekistan's strategy for AI technologies to 2030, within the Digital Uzbekistan 2030 strategy. Beside economic targets (AI-based software and services worth USD 1.5 billion, 10% of services on the public-services portal AI-based), it sets a regulatory agenda: a legal framework for AI, security and ethics requirements with ethical rules for developing and applying AI (draft legal act due December 2025), better rules on data protection and security, and harmonisation of nine national AI standards with international ones. A new Center for the Development of AI and the Digital Economy examines whether information systems and software are built on AI.
record.notes: Signed on 14 October 2024 and in force from 17 October 2024. The number is given as PQ-358 by the Ministry of Digital Technologies and as RP-358 in the English translation on lex.uz. The Minister of Digital Technologies is responsible for organising implementation and the Prime Minister oversees it; the Coordination Commission for the Digital Uzbekistan 2030 strategy reviews the priority AI projects. Presidential decrees amended the resolution: UP-189 of 22 October 2025 (loan terms, the Center's tasks, a restated 2024-2026 action plan), UP-223 of 21 November 2025 (the big-data list) and UP-141 of 24 July 2026 (targets, now 20 AI research laboratories; half-yearly monitoring by the Ministry of Digital Technologies; new chapters on monitoring and evaluation). lex.uz marks the Russian text of the Strategy, the action plan and the amendments as unofficial translations. Law ZRU-1115 of 21 January 2026 later added a definition of AI and general rules on its use to the Law on Informatization.

english_version.by: National Legal Information Centre "Adolat" under the Ministry of Justice of the Republic of Uzbekistan (lex.uz), marked as an unofficial translation

verification.note: Recheck of 17 Oct 2026: re-read the lex.uz English translation (document 7159258, stored 11 Oct 2026) and the Ministry of Digital Technologies release on gov.uz (stored again 17 Oct 2026), and stored on 17 Oct 2026 the official Uzbek text in its current edition (lex.uz document 7158604), the Russian text (7158606), the card of Decree UP-141 (8352898) and Decree UP-189 (7790236). The Uzbek text confirms the title, number, signature, entry into force on 17 October 2024, the editions of 27 October 2025, 22 November 2025 and 25 July 2026 with their amending decrees, and the provisions in the summary; the summary now follows the current Uzbek edition. The English translation on lex.uz renders the original 2024 text (for example 10, not 20, research laboratories). The archiver flagged the new lex.uz pages for review because the page title is short; their text is this resolution. The sentence on Law ZRU-1115 rests on the stored lex.uz text of that law (UZ-02).

changes.original_title: replaced with the verbatim titles of the stored official Uzbek text (lex.uz 7158604, Cyrillic) and the Russian text (7158606); version 1's Latin-script Uzbek title appears in no stored file and differs in wording
changes.date_last_updated: the current edition dates from 25 July 2026, when Decree UP-141 of 24 July 2026 was published in the National Database of Legislation
changes.summary: rewritten from the current Uzbek edition: the action-plan item on personal-data security in AI was replaced by UP-189, so the summary cites the Strategy's own data-protection task; the Center's role rendered literally (it examines whether systems are built on or use AI, not their safety)
changes.safety_topics: 'accountability & liability' (no liability rules) and 'evaluation & testing' (the Center's examination is of whether a system is AI-based, not a safety evaluation) replaced by 'public-sector use'
changes.notes: rewritten: implementation responsibility corrected, the three amending decrees and the unofficial status of the Russian translation added, the research-process remark removed
changes.english_version: the stored lex.uz document 7159258 is an English translation marked "Unofficial translation" and published by the Adolat centre of the Ministry of Justice, a public body

judgment.status_reasoning: lex.uz gives 17 October 2024 as the date of entry into force, which has passed. The later editions (27 October 2025, 22 November 2025, 25 July 2026) amend the resolution through decrees UP-189, UP-223 and UP-141; none repeals it. 'In force' stands.
judgment.scope_reasoning: A presidential resolution approving the national AI strategy, which includes a legal framework, security and ethical requirements for AI, standards and expert evaluation of AI systems; in scope with no note.
judgment.date_reasoning: date_published is the signing date (14 October 2024), date_in_force the lex.uz entry-into-force date (17 October 2024), date_last_updated the date of the current edition (25 July 2026, publication of UP-141 in the National Database of Legislation).
judgment.language_reasoning: language stays 'Uzbek, Russian': lex.uz marks the Russian text of the appendices and of the amendments as unofficial translations and refers to the official Uzbek text, but the Russian text of the resolution's own paragraphs carries no such mark.
